top = spark.sql("""
    SELECT product,
           count(*)      AS orders,
           sum(quantity) AS units,
           rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(quantity) DESC) AS units_rank
    FROM polaris.silver.orders VERSION AS OF <premier snapshot>
    GROUP BY product""")
top.writeTo("polaris.gold.top_products_spark").createOrReplace()
spark.sql("SELECT * FROM polaris.gold.top_products_spark ORDER BY units_rank")

spark.sql("""
    SELECT count(*) AS lignes_differentes FROM (
      (SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM polaris.gold.top_products
       EXCEPT SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM polaris.gold.top_products_spark)
      UNION ALL
      (SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM polaris.gold.top_products_spark
       EXCEPT SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM polaris.gold.top_products))""")  # Trino contre Spark, memes donnees

spark.sql("""
    SELECT count(*) AS lignes_differentes FROM (
      (SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM polaris.gold.top_products
       EXCEPT SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM (agregation de silver.orders actuel))
      UNION ALL
      (SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM (agregation de silver.orders actuel)
       EXCEPT SELECT product, orders, units, units_rank FROM polaris.gold.top_products))""")  # silver a recu un INSERT depuis
